metadata.title: Fusion 360 CAM Turning Per-Op Tab Deep Pass — Strategy / Cycle / Ramp / Holder / Output / Connections + 6 net-new turning ops
metadata.description: Deep-pass extension to turning-operations.json (MS0/U-CAM24). Closes the input-exhaust gap on the 5 existing turning ops by adding 6 previously-uncatalogued tabs (Strategy, Cycle for canned G70/G71/G72/G74/G75/G76 cycles, Ramp, Holder, Output, Connections), AND introduces 6 net-new turning ops (TURNING_CUTOFF parting-off, TURNING_BORE internal turning, TURNING_DRILL axial centerline, TURNING_TAP axial tap, TURNING_SECONDARY_SPINDLE_TRANSFER sub-spindle handoff turning subset, TURNING_LIVE_TOOLING C-axis driven-tool ops) that were missing entirely. Brings Fusion 360 turning toward 100% input-field coverage per L2-CAMX-EXHAUST mandate.
metadata.source: Autodesk Fusion 360 Help — Turning reference (Profile Roughing/Finishing, Face, Groove, Thread, Cutoff, Bore, Drill, Tap, Secondary Spindle, Live Tooling) + Fanuc 0i-TF / 30i-TF / 31i-TB G-code reference (G70 finish, G71 stock removal, G72 face stock removal, G74 peck drill, G75 grooving, G76 thread cycle) + Mazak Smooth-G turning manual + Okuma OSP-P300 turning manual + post.cps Manual NC reference + Sandvik Coromant turning insert geometry guide

commonTabs.description: New tabs added by the deep pass on top of existing base (tool/geometry/passes; only profile_roughing has heights). The deep pass adds Strategy/Cycle/Ramp/Holder/Output/Connections to all ops; net-new ops use the full turning tab structure (Tool/Geometry/Heights/Passes/Cycle/Strategy/Ramp/Holder/Output/Connections).

TURNING_PROFILE_ROUGHING_DEEP.description: Deep-tab extension to turning_profile_roughing — Strategy / Cycle (G71 stock-removal cycle) / Ramp / Holder / Output / Connections.

parameters.name: Climb Cutting
parameters.description: Cutting direction relative to spindle rotation

parameters.name: G71 Retract Distance
parameters.description: G71 R-word — retract amount per peck

parameters.name: Constant Surface Speed
parameters.description: G96 — auto-adjust RPM to maintain SFM

TURNING_PROFILE_FINISHING_DEEP.description: Deep-tab extension to turning_profile_finishing — Strategy / Cycle (G70 finish cycle) / Ramp / Holder / Output / Connections.

parameters.name: Reference Roughing Op
parameters.description: G71/G72 op that defined the contour

TURNING_FACE_DEEP.description: Deep-tab extension to turning_face — Strategy / Cycle (G72 face-stock-removal) / Ramp / Holder / Output / Connections.

TURNING_GROOVE_DEEP.description: Deep-tab extension to turning_groove — Strategy / Cycle (G75 grooving) / Ramp / Holder / Output / Connections.

parameters.name: Constant Surface Speed
parameters.description: G96 not recommended for narrow grooves; prefer G97 fixed RPM

TURNING_THREAD_DEEP.description: Deep-tab extension to turning_thread — Strategy / Cycle (G76 multi-repetitive thread) / Ramp / Holder / Output / Connections. Covers single-point threading with infeed angle, multi-pass depth schedule, and Fanuc/Mazak/Okuma cycle variants.

parameters.name: Infeed Angle
parameters.description: Half-thread-angle infeed (29° for ACME, 30° for UN/M)

parameters.name: Spring Pass
parameters.description: Final zero-depth pass to clean up

parameters.name: G76 Pullout Distance
parameters.description: G76 R-word — chamfer pullout at thread end

parameters.name: Lead-In Distance
parameters.description: Pre-thread approach distance for spindle sync

parameters.name: Constant Surface Speed
parameters.description: G97 fixed RPM required for threading — disable G96

parameters.name: Threading RPM
parameters.description: Fixed spindle speed (must remain stable for pitch sync)

TURNING_CUTOFF.description: Net-new turning op — parting-off (cutoff). Cuts the finished part from the bar stock with controlled radial plunge, peck-cutoff for chip control, and optional dwell at center for clean break. Critical for bar-fed production.

parameters.name: Cutoff Z Position
parameters.description: Z-axis position of the cutoff plane

parameters.name: Cutoff to ID
parameters.description: Final radius (0 = full cutoff to center)

parameters.name: Tool Width
parameters.description: Cutoff blade width — drives tool wear

parameters.name: Approach Distance
parameters.description: Radial distance above stock OD for rapid approach

parameters.name: Reduce Feed at Center
parameters.description: Slow feed near centerline (prevents tool overload)

parameters.name: Use Part Catcher
parameters.description: Trigger part catcher M-code at cutoff

parameters.name: Spindle Stop at Center
parameters.description: M5 just before final break (clean snap)

parameters.name: Dwell at Center
parameters.description: Pause at last 0.1mm to ensure clean break

parameters.name: Air Blast at Center
parameters.description: M-code air blast to clear chips

parameters.name: Constant Surface Speed
parameters.description: G96 not used at center — must auto-cap to G97 below threshold

parameters.name: Bar Feed M-Code
parameters.description: M-code to advance bar feeder for next part

TURNING_BORE.description: Net-new turning op — internal turning (boring). Removes material from existing pilot/drilled hole using boring bar. Covers ID profile roughing, finishing, threading, grooving — separates internal vs external strategies because boring-bar deflection budget is critical.

parameters.name: Coolant
parameters.description: Through-tool strongly preferred for chip evacuation

parameters.name: Tool Stickout
parameters.description: Boring bar stickout — drives deflection budget

parameters.name: Bar Length to Diameter Ratio
parameters.description: Auto-computed flag: warn if >4 for steel, >6 for carbide bar

parameters.name: Approach Diameter
parameters.description: Diameter at which rapid approach begins

parameters.name: Spring Pass
parameters.description: Zero-depth final pass to compensate for bar deflection

parameters.name: Reduce Feedrate Near Bottom
parameters.description: Slow feed near blind-bore bottom for surface finish

parameters.name: Bar Material
parameters.description: Carbide shanks allow higher L:D ratios

TURNING_DRILL.description: Net-new turning op — axial centerline drilling on a lathe (drill held in turret/tailstock). Distinct from milling drill — uses turning's coordinate system, peck-drilling cycles tuned for axial chip evacuation, and integrates with Z-axis spindle.

parameters.name: Tool
parameters.description: Twist drill, gun drill, indexable drill, or center drill

parameters.name: Constant Surface Speed
parameters.description: G97 fixed RPM for drilling — disable G96

TURNING_TAP.description: Net-new turning op — axial tapping on a lathe (tap held in turret or tailstock with tension/compression head, OR rigid-tap synced to spindle). Auto-binds Pitch + RPM + Feed via F = N × P (mm/min) for rigid sync.

parameters.name: Tapping RPM
parameters.description: Fixed (G97) — required for rigid-tap pitch sync

TURNING_SECONDARY_SPINDLE_TRANSFER.description: Net-new turning op — sub-spindle/secondary-spindle handoff on a multi-spindle lathe. Subset of mill-turn TURNING_TRANSFER but for pure-turning controllers without C-axis. Synchronizes RPMs, advances sub-spindle to grip, parts off, retracts. For Mazak Quick Turn / DMG MORI NLX / Okuma Genos L300M sub-spindle machines.

parameters.name: Part Position Z
parameters.description: Z-position of part nose at transfer

parameters.name: Gripping Length
parameters.description: Stock length to grip in sub-spindle

parameters.name: Push Out Distance
parameters.description: Stock advance from main chuck before pickup

parameters.name: Tailstock Used
parameters.description: Whether tailstock supports OD before transfer

parameters.name: Part Catcher M-Code
parameters.description: If part lands in catcher (vs sub-spindle pickup)

TURNING_LIVE_TOOLING.description: Net-new turning op — driven-tool ops on a turning-center with live-tool turret + C-axis (cross-drilling, axial milling, off-center features). For Mazak Multus / Okuma L300M / Doosan Lynx with C-axis. Distinct from full mill-turn — these are turret-mounted driven tools without sub-spindle synchronization.

parameters.name: Feature C-Axis Angle
parameters.description: Initial C-axis index for the feature

parameters.name: Tool Tip Z
parameters.description: Z-position of tool tip at start

parameters.name: C-Axis Brake
parameters.description: Engage spindle brake during indexed cuts

parameters.name: M-Code Live Tool On
parameters.description: Custom M-code to start tool spindle (e.g., M133)

parameters.name: Constant Surface Speed
parameters.description: G96 not used during live-tool work — main spindle locked
